usedFor: Fluent Forms collects submissions, and HubSpot stores the sender when “New Form Submission” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submission” in Fluent Forms, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Every submission becomes a HubSpot contact with the properties from the form.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so the form needs an email field.
